chars.YASSINE: YASSINE: a slim Moroccan young man about 27, short curly black hair, light stubble, wearing a mustard-yellow hooded sweatshirt and dark blue jeans
chars.SALMA: SALMA: a young Moroccan woman about 25, long dark wavy hair partly under a loose burgundy headscarf, wearing a long emerald-green kaftan-style house dress
chars.MAMA: MAMA: a plump Moroccan mother in her late fifties with a round kind face, white headscarf and a beige djellaba
chars.AUNTS: THE AUNTS: two loud middle-aged Moroccan women in bright pink and orange floral djellabas, gold bangles and heavy makeup

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Modest Casablanca apartment living room with Moroccan sofas. YASSINE stands with arms crossed, one eyebrow raised, suspiciously staring at SALMA; SALMA freezes mid-step holding a tea tray, eyes darting sideways, nervous awkward smile. Comic tension, cartoon style.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Same living room. YASSINE leans forward on the sofa, palms open, asking insistently; SALMA sits opposite, turning her face away and fiddling with her headscarf, avoiding the question.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Narrow stairwell of an old Moroccan apartment building. SALMA walks ahead knocking on a green metal door; YASSINE and MAMA follow behind her carrying a box of Moroccan pastries, curious and uneasy.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Colorful Moroccan salon with patterned cushions and mint tea. MAMA sits stiffly on the sofa, clutching her handbag, side-eyeing THE AUNTS who whisper to each other behind their hands and giggle suspiciously.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Same salon. YASSINE glances worriedly at MAMA; MAMA gives him a small, wary look with pursed lips, as if saying 'something is off here'. Background slightly blurred.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Night, YASSINE sits on a plastic chair outside a small Moroccan cafe under a street lamp, holding his phone, his face lit by the screen, shocked wide eyes. The phone screen is seen from behind only.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Daytime doorway of an old Moroccan building. YASSINE stands at the open door asking questions; THE AUNTS block the doorway, shrugging and waving their hands evasively, fake smiles.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Evening in the small Moroccan apartment. In the foreground YASSINE stands frozen reading his phone, mouth open in shock; in the background through the kitchen door SALMA cooks, unaware, humming. Dramatic suspense lighting.
